stage: Experiment1 development pilot; local short-hole MAT messaging

basis.local_interval: Same S/T functions, normalized arc length on middle32/48px subcurve, NOT original whole curve

groups.G1: old canny_native MAT ordinary binary repair, no message
groups.G2: G1 supported ridge followed by fixed S/T coefficient projection, preserving small orthogonal MAT residual
groups.G3: frozen MAT W+ latent optimized with message shape/coefficient constraints, followed by SAME projection as G2
groups.G4: unchanged RasterWarp S/T on original local source, no MAT

mat.precision: float32 params, CUDA bfloat16 forward; deterministic reset of intrinsic MAT dropout per forward
mat.inference_optimization: Adam W+ only,48steps,lr0.04; model parameters frozen. Not a trained message conditional network.
mat.constraint: 0.8 soft ridge target BCE +2 normal-moment MSE +0.1 G1-preservation L1 +0.002 W+ displacement MSE; fixed anchors and known pixels copied
mat.projection: Require real binary MAT path coverage>=.65/span>=.8/residual<=1.5, bit-blind path min-cost; set coefficients to clean-origin+nominal centers, residual shrink<=.25, no direct-G4 fallback

receiver.implementation: existing R0/A3 joint S/T Huber and geometry gates, unchanged
receiver.decoder: same four nominal centers +/-amplitude relative to original input clean coefficients; no expected-word path selection
receiver.presence: Fixed nearest-codeword-vs-clean-origin: d_clean^2>d_nearest^2 AND d_nearest<=.75*amplitude. Exploratory, no calibrated FPR guarantee.
receiver.old_long_curve_channel: Not refitted or silently transferred to short local geometry; nominal centers used consistently in input/RGB

rgb_gate: G3 PNGs: ALL40 attempts have accepted Auto geometry, correct full2bit, active changes, four distinct per content, exterior unchanged. No failure filtering.
escalation: Test32 first; if gate fails, test48 with SAME hyperparameters and retain all32 failures. If neither passes, NO diffusion. All10 contents retained.

quality.reference: same prompt/seed clean output; diagnostic source comparison also reported
quality.policy: All marked attempts included; zero-change outputs not accepted as transmission

limitations: Existing historical stability selection + development10, no new independent test. Original ordered source reference supplied; not RGB-only blind decoding. Presence is not authenticated watermark.
